angleRead.name: Tamsin Pruitt
angleRead.text: I want to write one Lives piece about three people who work, or worked, under the same roof at the Baylight Construction Authority. All three had a week at work this cycle that went differently. Sahana Joshi, an elevator mechanic in KONO, finished the week with the hardest account on the floor squared away. Geneva Zhou, an elevator mechanic in West Oakland, watched a coworker with less time in get the assignment she had asked about. Bea Cartier, a roofing contractor in Laurel, was left off the invite to the meeting about her own account. I would write it as a plain page of what happened, with no verdict on the Authority. For each person I want the one detail their household would pick. For S

plan.chase: I want to write one Lives piece about three people who work, or worked, under the same roof at the Baylight Construction Authority. All three had a week at work this cycle that went differently. Sahana Joshi, an elevator mechanic in KONO, finished the week with the hardest account on the floor squared away. Geneva Zhou, an elevator mechanic in West Oakland, watched a coworker with less time in get the assignment she had asked about. Bea Cartier, a roofing contractor in Laurel, was left off the invite to the meeting about her own account. I would write it as a plain page of what happened, with no verdict on the Authority. For each person I want the one detail their household would pick. For S
plan.focus: Three people tied to one employer, the Baylight Construction Authority, and one week that went well for one, and went unnoticed or sideways for the other two.
plan.why: The record has a real event for each of the three. A promotion-type win went to Sahana. Geneva was passed over for an assignment. Bea was left off an invite. They are tied to the same business ID (BIZ-00020) and to the city's biggest build. That gives the Lives page a human, specific look at who gets in the room, without editorializing. The other candidates have only quiet, inner moments this cycle.
checks: Confirm with each person which week the event happened in. The ledger tags Sahana's promotion as C13 and Bea's left-off-the-invite entry as both Y3C9 and Y3C13 in different lists, so the cycle labels may be mixed up.
Bea Cartier's ledger stage is retired, but the record says she was left off a meeting about her own account. Ask her what her role there is before I describe it.
Confirm all three are on the Baylight Construction Authority payroll or contract, since the ledger shows only the business ID BIZ-00020.
Do not name the coworker who got Geneva's assignment unless Geneva or the Authority names them. Winston Clarke is a friend in her record, not that coworker.
Don't link the three events as cause and effect. They sit side by side on one cycle's record.

targets.question: You finished the week with the hardest account on the floor squared away. What was that account, what did it take, and what did you do when it closed?
targets.basis: Her ledger entry is a promotion-up life event at the Baylight Construction Authority. The week ended with her toughest account squared away.

targets.question: You asked about an assignment and a coworker with less time in got it. What was the assignment, how did you hear, and what did you do next?
targets.basis: Her ledger entry is a promotion-down life event at the Authority. The record also shows the savings jar for Oaks season tickets and her walking past the Temescal Community Health Center renderings.

targets.question: You weren't on the invite for the meeting about your own account. What is your account, how did you find out about the meeting, and what happened to the tickets on the counter?
targets.basis: Her ledger entry shows she was left off the invite at the Authority, and the tickets were left unused on the counter. Her record also shows the third storefront papered over this year.

plan.interpretation: The three records read like one workplace seen from three seats. Whether that is a pattern or coincidence is not something the ledger can say. The page should report only what each person confirms.
unverifiedLead: Whether the Authority assigns accounts by seniority, and whether that played any part in what happened to Geneva.
Whether Bea's account and Sahana's hardest account are the same account.
Whether Bea is still active at the Authority despite her retired career stage.
